edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the sender address used by _transfer, so the caller drives token movement.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of funds.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender.
unlock requires msg.sender to equal _previousOwner.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
lock computes _lockTime from block.timestamp plus a caller-supplied duration.
unlock is gated by block.timestamp being greater than _lockTime.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
_transfer delegates final processing to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify, which performs external swaps and ETH sends before balances settle.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded pairs.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded.
_transferStandard obtains fee values via _getValues.
_transferStandard routes liquidity portion through _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_transferToExcluded obtains fee values via _getValues.
_transferFromExcluded obtains fee values via _getValues.
_transferBothExcluded obtains fee values via _getValues.
_getValues derives token-space values via _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection-space values via _getRValues.
_getValues fetches the current rate via _getRate.
_getTValues computes the tax fee via calculateTaxFee.
_getTValues computes the liquidity fee via calculateLiquidityFee.
_getRate derives supplies via _getCurrentSupply.
swapAndLiquify swaps half the tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds the remaining tokens and ETH as liquidity.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
addLiquidity approves the router through _approve.
airdropArray loops calling airdropInternal.
airdropInternal performs the transfer through _transfer.
airdrop performs the transfer through _transfer.
airdrop zeroes fees before transferring.
airdrop restores fees after transferring.
balanceOf converts reflection balance through tokenFromReflection.
excludeFromReward snapshots the token balance via tokenFromReflection.
_takeLiquidity fetches the current rate via _getRate.
claimTokens sends the full ETH balance to the marketing wallet via an external call.
clearStuckBalance sends the contract ETH balance to a caller-supplied address.
swapTokensForEth invokes the Uniswap router swap that transfers control externally.
addLiquidity invokes the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
swapAndLiquify sends the marketing share of ETH via an external call.
claimOtherTokens calls transfer on an owner-supplied ERC20 contract.
The router swap path transfers tokens back through this contract's _transfer entry, allowing reentry.
addLiquidityETH moves tokens via transferFrom into the pair, re-entering token transfer logic.
ETH sent to the marketing wallet can trigger its fallback and re-enter this contract.
ETH sent by clearStuckBalance can re-enter the contract fallback.
ETH sent by claimTokens can re-enter the contract fallback.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
_takeLiquidity credits the liquidity portion to the contract reflection balance.
_transferStandard updates reflection balances of sender and recipient.
_transferToExcluded updates the recipient token balance in _tOwned.
_transferFromExcluded updates the sender token balance in _tOwned.
_transferBothExcluded updates token balances in _tOwned for both sides.
_transferBothExcluded updates reflection balances in _rOwned for both sides.
removeAllFee sets _taxFee to zero after caching it.
removeAllFee sets _liquidityFee to zero after caching it.
restoreAllFee writes the cached tax fee back to _taxFee.
restoreAllFee writes the cached liquidity fee back to _liquidityFee.
setMarketingWallet, owner-only, writes the marketing wallet address.
upliftTxAmount, owner-only, raises the max transaction amount.
setSwapThresholdAmount, owner-only, writes the swap threshold.
claimTokens reads the marketing wallet as the ETH destination.
swapAndLiquify reads the marketing wallet as the ETH destination.
allowtrading, owner-only, enables public trading.
addBotWallet, owner-only, writes the bot blacklist.
removeBotWallet, owner-only, clears a blacklist entry.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled, owner-only, toggles automatic swapping.
lock writes _lockTime using the caller-supplied duration.
lock clears the current owner address.
lock stores the previous owner for later unlock.
unlock restores the previous owner into _owner.
constructor creates and assigns the Uniswap pair address.
constructor assigns the immutable router address.
_transfer reads and enforces the max transaction amount.
_transfer compares the contract balance against the swap threshold.
_tokenTransfer gates trades on canTrade, restricting activity to the owner pre-launch.
_tokenTransfer checks the bot blacklist for sender and recipient.
from parameter flows into _transfer validation and transfer logic.
to parameter flows into _transfer validation and transfer logic.
amount parameter is checked against _maxTxAmount inside _transfer.
sender parameter drives fee and exclusion branching in _tokenTransfer.
recipient parameter drives fee and exclusion branching in _tokenTransfer.
tAmount parameter feeds _getValues in _transferStandard.
account parameter is excluded and snapshotted in excludeFromReward.
walletaddress parameter is the ETH destination in clearStuckBalance.
contractTokenBalance is the amount passed into swapAndLiquify.
takeFee flag controls fee removal inside _tokenTransfer.
overMinTokenBalance gates whether swapAndLiquify executes.
half is the token amount swapped for ETH.
otherHalf is the token amount added to liquidity.
initialBalance is captured to measure ETH gained by the swap.
newBalance determines the ETH amount forwarded to the marketing wallet.
marketingshare is the exact ETH amount sent to the marketing wallet.
